# AI Converter full context

AI Converter is a web app for automated AI conversion and browser-local image/SVG conversion. Bank statement PDF to CSV is the first production AI module.

## Current product wedge

The production AI module is bank statement PDF to CSV. Receipt, invoice, screenshot-table, audio transcript, document-to-Markdown, screenshot-to-HTML, and provider-backed universal file conversion are beta/provider modules on the same preview-first path when configured. PNG/JPG/WEBP image format conversion and raster-to-SVG conversion are browser-local modules and do not upload files. Pixel-perfect image-to-code is not claimed.

Live behavior:
- Direct browser upload for bank statement PDFs.
- PDF upload limit: 50 MB.
- Page-pack pricing up to 500 pages.
- Built-in parser first for digital PDFs.
- OCR fallback for scanned or messy PDFs when configured.
- Free sample preview before payment.
- Paid full extraction and CSV download.
- One automatic stronger redo for paid jobs.
- Low-confidence conversions fail closed.
- No human file review queue.
- No emailed bank statements in the live bank-statement workflow.
- Receipt image or PDF to expense CSV is beta. It can export vendor, date, category, total, tax, payment method, and notes when safely detected.
- Invoice or bill image/PDF to CSV or JSON is beta. It can export vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, subtotal, tax, total, payment terms, notes, and JSON line items when safely detected.
- Screenshot PNG, JPG, WEBP, or image PDF to spreadsheet CSV is beta. It can infer table rows and headers when safely detected.
- Image format conversion from PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP to PNG, JPG, or WEBP is live as a browser-local route. It does not use the server upload, D1, R2, Mistral, or Dodo workflow.
- Raster-to-SVG conversion from PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP to SVG is live as a browser-local posterized route. It does not use the server upload, D1, R2, Mistral, or Dodo workflow.
- Audio transcript from MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, or WEBM to TXT or JSON is beta and uses Cloudflare Workers AI speech recognition when configured.
- Document Markdown conversion for Cloudflare-supported rich document formats is beta and uses Cloudflare Workers AI Markdown Conversion when configured.
- Screenshot to HTML is beta. It creates a clean starter preview and uses Workers AI vision for paid image exports when configured. It does not claim pixel-perfect screenshot cloning.
- Universal file conversion for documents, images, audio, video, and archives is provider-backed through CloudConvert first, with Convertio as a configured backup route. Long provider jobs run in the background and update automatically.
- Beta modules use OCR and can fail closed when structure confidence is too low.

## Pricing

- Free preview.
- Starter: $3 for 25 pages or images.
- Standard: $5 for 100 pages or images.
- Bulk: $9 for 500 pages or images.

## Data handling

- Source files are private.
- Source files are kept for preview, paid unlock, and the redo window.
- Source files are deleted after failed extraction, completed redo, or the 24-hour source lifecycle.
- Generated files expire after 7 days.
- API responses for sensitive routes are marked no-store.
- Job access uses a job ID and random token.

## Output shape

Typical CSV columns:
- date
- description
- money_in
- money_out
- balance

Beta receipt CSV columns:
- date
- vendor
- category
- total
- currency
- subtotal
- tax
- payment_method
- notes

Beta screenshot/table CSV columns are inferred from the visible table when safe. Markdown tables, OCR table blocks, HTML table output, and obvious date-description-amount rows are handled.

Beta invoice CSV columns:
- vendor
- invoice_number
- invoice_date
- due_date
- total
- currency
- subtotal
- tax
- payment_terms
- notes

Beta invoice JSON includes the invoice summary, line_items when safely detected, warnings, and confidence.

Beta audio TXT contains the transcript. Beta audio JSON contains transcript, word count, optional VTT, and words when returned by the provider.

Beta document Markdown exports `.md`. Screenshot-to-HTML exports `.html` based on detected readable content and structure.

Fake sample CSV:
- https://aiconverter.app/sample-bank-statement.csv

## Upcoming, not live as primary bank-statement intake

- AI-monitored email intake after the secure direct upload workflow is stable.

## Claims to avoid

Do not claim AI Converter supports every bank, every statement format, every receipt format, every invoice format, every screenshot layout, every audio file, every document, every image format, every file type, certified compliance, human review, guaranteed accuracy, accounting or tax advice, instant AI processing, pixel-perfect screenshot-to-code, or customer-volume proof. Provider-backed video/archive/file conversion depends on a configured provider accepting that exact input/output pair. Exports should be reviewed before important use.
